AUTHOR: Z. Hu
TITLE: MOA-YOLO: An Accurate, Real-Time, and Lightweight YOLOv10-Based Algorithm for Deep-Sea Fish Detection
REGION: Southern California Bight, USA (NOAA Labeled Fishes in the Wild); extra tests on Fish4Knowledge and LifeCLEF 2015
SPECIES: fish (single class; Sebastes spp. and other bottom fishes)
DATA: 1200 images (3640 fish) selected from NOAA Labeled Fishes in the Wild; Fish4Knowledge and LifeCLEF 2015 in extended experiments
V_EV: Sec. IV-J: 'the above algorithms are conducted in low-light scenes, blurred scenes, and turbid scenes' (Figs. 18-20, qualitative examples only)
D_EV: Sec. IV-A: 'The labeled images are divided into the training set and validation set at a ratio of 5:1'
R_EV: Sec. IV-K: 'these algorithms are conducted on the Fish4Knowledge [45] and LifeCLEF 2015 [46] datasets' — not stated that LFW-trained model was applied without retraining
E_EV: Sec. IV-C: 'evaluated in terms of the precision (P), recall (R), mean average precision (mAP), parameter number (Param), ... and frames per second (FPS)'
ARCH: MOA-YOLO: YOLOv10s + ASNet enhancement + multihead latent attention + ONWD loss + AKConv/AKC2f; deployed on Jetson Xavier NX
METR: Precision, recall, mAP50, mAP50:95, params, FLOPs, FPS; small-object AP (<32x32 px)
NOTE: LFW (ROV rockfish surveys) qualifies under INCL. Validation set doubles as test set. Extended experiments on Fish4Knowledge/LifeCLEF 2015 (Tables VIII-IX) — paper does not say whether models were retrained; coded R1=N (lower-information choice), verifier should check. E4='크기별' because small-target (<32x32) AP is reported (Table VII). ENV: paper frames as 'deep-sea' but LFW is Southern California Bight rocky-bank shelf habitat; coded 온대 암반/켈프 — check. DSHR '공개' refers to public LFW source data; own relabels not released. Code on GitHub (hu167/code).
